combinations.readout: Aβ fiber-mediated allodynia-like withdrawal behavior after nerve injury
combinations.magnitude: duloxetine suppression abolished in knockdown rats
combinations.model: spinal nerve injury (PNI) in W-TChR2V4 rats, 2 weeks
combinations.evidence_quote: We further found that the suppressive effects of duloxetine were abolished in AAV-NpyP+ neuron-specific α1B-AR-knockdown (Figure 3B).

combinations.magnitude: NA-induced depolarization prevented; proportion hyperpolarized increased
combinations.evidence_quote: NA-induced depolarization in AAV-NpyP+ neurons was prevented by the α1B-AR antagonist L-765,314 (Figure 1C) but not by silodosin (α1A-AR) or A-315456 (α1D-AR).

combinations.readout: NA-induced membrane potential responses of AAV-NpyP+ SDH neurons
combinations.evidence_quote: When L-765,314 was treated, the proportion of AAV-NpyP+ neurons exhibiting hyperpolarization increased, and co-treatment with atipamezole (α2-AR antagonist) abolished the NA-induced responses (Figure 1C,D).

combinations.magnitude: NA failed to depolarize almost all mCherry+ neurons
combinations.evidence_quote: Electrophysiological recordings revealed that the NA failed to depolarize almost all mCherry+ neurons (Figure 2B,C).
